main_text.p: soluentibus, aut si deniq; narcoticis admotis incrassati sint in tophos tandem degenerant. Cæterae vero arthritidis species, præter hereditariam, quæ nondum callos contraxerint, non per se, sed ex accidenti, hoc est, agyrtarum, empyricorum, & nephandorum paracelsistarum imposturis, atq; etiam Grammaticalium medicorum, garulorum (quorum non parua hodie turba est) ignoratione, ægrotantium deniq; aut egestate, aut summa, qua omnes fere diuites arthritici uruntur auaritia, insanabiles dunta-xat relinquuntur. Quare arthritidem omnem opprobrium medicorum esse, perpe-ram scripsit Fernelius.
main_text.head: EXERC. L.
DE QUIBUSDAM REMEDIIS arthritidis, quæ sanabilis est.
main_text.p: Quod ad sanabilium arthriticorum remedia attinet, quę à Galeno, Paulo Ægineta, Aëtio, Guilielmo Ron-deletio nostri ævi medicorum totius Gal-liæ splendore, & ab aliis medicinæ peritis probè & appositè scripta fuerint, huc pro-ducere, superuacaneum nobis visum est: sed ea duntaxat vel proponere, quæ vel ab his

page.notes: Large initial Q of "Quod" is printed as a woodcut-style capital. Line-end hyphens in "perpe-ram", "Ron-deletio", "Gal-liæ" and "pro-ducere" are printed and kept. The break in "nephan-dorum" has no printed hyphen and is written whole. Long s is read as plain s throughout, so the printed "f" forms (for example "foluentibus", "imposturis") are corrected to "s". Running head and paragraph text are otherwise clear; no words are marked uncertain.
